card.name: Table numbers in cross-references
card.fires_on: The digit naming a table (such as 3, 4 or 6) right after the word Table when the text points the reader to a table of doses, interactions or trial results.

modes.label: Pointer to a table
modes.description: The table number in a sentence saying results or dosing are presented or shown in that table.
modes.example: Data from the short-term, placebo-controlled bipolar mania trial are presented in Table <<4>> .

modes.label: See Table reference
modes.description: The table number inside parentheses as a see-also pointer, often about drug interactions.
